subject: Taxes
title: The Criminal Investigation Division
description: A 60-second lesson on The Criminal Investigation Division.

hook.text: IRS Criminal Investigation has 2,000 armed special agents. They carry badges, guns, and authority to arrest.

buildup.text: CI agents investigate tax fraud, money laundering, and financial crimes.

discovery.text: CI uses 'follow the money' techniques pioneered against organized crime.

twist.text: The division is shrinking. Agent count dropped from 3,200 in 2010 to under 2,000 today.

climax.text: IRS-CI is one of the most effective law enforcement units ever created—and it's slowly disappearing as budgets tighten.

punchline.text: 90% conviction rate. 2,000 agents left. The best unit is fading away.

quiz.question: What is the conviction rate of IRS Criminal Investigation?
